answer.says: Guten Tag. I require the morning paper. The news of the world must be known, even if the world is merely a system of needs in a horseshoe.
answer.thought: I have arrived at the market, the arena of civil society where want is mediated through work. My pockets hold only ninety-six rupees, a pittance against the vast machinery of exchange here, but the news is a necessity of the spirit, not a luxury of the belly. I shall purchase the paper; the stomach can wait for the next phase of the dialectic, or I shall simply endure the hunger as a moment of negation.
